tex_content.html:
Remark
[Evolving necks of rescaled time greater than one] ↗ def:evolving-epsilon-neck

This is compatible with the time interval $[0,1)$ because the neck scale is $R(x,t)^{-1/2}$, which tends to $0$ as $t\to 1$.

Corollary
[Points near the tip lie in a canonical cap]
